book.title: 搅拌车的肚子为什么一直转
book.subtitle: 绕个弯，也要稳稳送到
book.question: 搅拌车的滚筒为什么不停转？

moral.zh: 材料要合适，时间要安排，遇到变化及时沟通。
moral.en: Use suitable materials, plan the timing and communicate when plans change.

parentGuide.goal: 理解材料、时间和沟通共同影响结果。
parentGuide.reminder: 不把搅拌车讲成转着就永远不会硬的魔法车。
questions: 混凝土和水泥是一回事吗？
绕路后为什么要联系工地并再次检查？
parentGuide.activity: 成人封好装有水与干净小石子的透明瓶，轻转再静置看变化；这不是混凝土实验。

ageTips.age4to5: 每次听几个动作就好，允许配音、指图和重复最喜欢的一页。
ageTips.age6to8: 请孩子解释一次遇到困难后的选择，比较两种车的分工，不要求背术语。

pages.zhText: 清早，一辆圆肚子的搅拌车经过参观区。呼噜噜，肚子还在转！安安问妈妈：“它一边走，一边在做大蛋糕吗？”
pages.enText: Early in the morning, a round-bellied mixer truck passed the visitor area. Whirr—its drum was turning! “Is it baking a giant cake as it goes?” An'an asked Mom.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Hero white-cab green-white drum mixer passing fenced observation area morning.

pages.zhText: 林工程师笑着说：“它送的是混凝土，今天要浇筑小桥旁的平台。”安安指着滚筒：“原来里面装的不是面糊呀！”
pages.enText: “It is carrying concrete for a platform beside the little bridge,” Lin smiled. An'an pointed at the drum. “So it isn't cake batter!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Visitor shelter overlooking distant prepared platform and mixer, Lin explains to An'an.

pages.zhText: 混凝土和水泥不是同一种东西。水泥像配方里的一个成员，还要按要求配上水、沙子和石子等材料，才能做成需要的混凝土。
pages.enText: Concrete and cement are not the same thing. Cement is one ingredient, combined with water, sand, stone and other materials in a specified mix to make concrete.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Educational visitor table sealed sample containers of cement powder sand gravel water beside hardened concrete sample, no labels, no dust.

pages.zhText: 在搅拌站，材料按配方计量，再搅拌均匀。不是随便多加一桶水，就能变得更好用。安安点头：“做东西也要守配方。”
pages.enText: At the mixing plant, ingredients were measured and mixed according to the recipe. Adding extra water at random would not improve it. “A recipe matters,” An'an nodded.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide clean enclosed batching plant loading mixer drum, workers in protected control room, no exposed dust.

pages.zhText: 装好后，大滚筒继续慢慢转。里面的叶片带着混凝土翻动，帮助它保持均匀，减少材料分开沉下去。呼噜噜，是出发前的准备声。
pages.enText: After loading, the drum kept turning slowly. Blades inside moved the concrete to help keep it uniform and reduce separation. Whirr—it was ready to leave.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close external striped drum slowly rotating, optional separate small enclosed museum model of internal spiral, no impossible exposed full-size drum.

pages.zhText: 妈妈说：“一直转，也不能让混凝土永远不硬。工作人员还要管理时间、温度和材料状态。”安安说：“它是有时间安排的快递！”
pages.enText: “Turning cannot stop concrete from hardening forever,” Mom said. “The team must manage time, temperature and its condition.” “A delivery with a schedule!” An'an replied.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Visitor area Lin pointing at blank round clock and wordless delivery plan, mixer visible outside.

pages.zhText: 司机出发前确认路线，工地也准备好了接货的人和设备。搅拌车不是到哪里随便倒，而是去约定的地方。
pages.enText: The driver confirmed the route, and the site prepared people and equipment to receive the load. The truck would not pour just anywhere: it had an agreed destination.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Driver in parked cab reviewing generic route map no text, organized site receiving bay beyond.

pages.zhText: 半路上，一段道路临时封闭。搅拌车停在允许等待的位置，司机联系调度。安安从人行道远远看见：“大肚子遇到绕路啦！”
pages.enText: A road was temporarily closed. The truck stopped where waiting was allowed, and the driver contacted dispatch. Watching from the sidewalk, An'an said, “The big belly needs a detour!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Covered road closure barriers distant, mixer safely parked in designated bay, driver on hands-free radio, visitors on protected sidewalk.

pages.zhText: 调度重新安排路线，也把消息告诉工地。大家一起判断这车混凝土能否按要求使用。着急不能代替检查，更不能闯红灯。
pages.enText: Dispatch arranged a new route and informed the site. Together they assessed whether the concrete could still meet requirements. Hurrying could not replace checks—or justify running red lights.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Parked mixer driver communicating by radio, abstract wordless route alternative on tablet, calm no speeding.

pages.zhText: 车到了，工作人员检查这批混凝土的资料和状态。确认符合要求，才安排卸料。安安松口气：“不是赶到就算完成，还要检查好。”
pages.enText: At the site, workers checked the batch information and condition. Only after confirming it met requirements did unloading begin. “Arriving isn't enough; it must be checked,” An'an said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Mixer stationary receiving station, PPE worker performing supervised concrete sampling on protected slab, child far behind fence.

pages.zhText: 司机让滚筒按卸料需要改变转动方向，里面的叶片把混凝土送向出口。后面的溜槽已经对好位置，工作人员站在安全处配合。
pages.enText: The driver changed the drum's direction for unloading. Its blades moved concrete toward the outlet. The rear chute was aligned, and workers assisted from safe positions.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Accurate rear mixer discharge chute aligned to receiving hopper, rotating drum intact, workers clear of moving parts.

pages.zhText: 哗——湿湿的混凝土沿溜槽流下去。林工程师说：“不能用手摸，更不能赤脚踩。施工人员要穿戴好防护用品。”
pages.enText: Whoosh—wet concrete flowed down the chute. “Do not touch it or step in barefoot,” Lin said. “Workers must wear proper protection.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close concrete flowing chute into designated form, PPE adults rubber boots gloves at safe working position, visitors distant.

pages.zhText: 平台的形状靠模板围好，钢筋按设计布置。搅拌车负责送材料，后面还有浇筑、振实和表面处理等工作。
pages.enText: Forms defined the platform, and reinforcement followed the design. The mixer delivered material; placing, consolidating and finishing still remained.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide prepared reinforced platform forms being poured by professional crew with suitable PPE, mixer rear beside zone.

pages.zhText: 平台浇好了，也不能马上踩上去。工作人员养护、保护它，等达到要求再开放。安安问：“原来变结实，还需要耐心呀？”
pages.enText: Even after pouring, the platform could not be walked on immediately. Workers cured and protected it until it met requirements. “Getting strong takes patience, too?” An'an asked.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Fresh concrete platform fenced off with damp curing covering applied, no children inside.

pages.zhText: 搅拌车去指定清洗区洗好设备，废水也集中处理。它没有把剩料倒进小河。安安看着河边的树：“公园和河水都要照顾。”
pages.enText: The mixer went to a designated washout area, where wastewater was collected. It did not dump leftovers in the stream. “We must care for both the park and the river,” An'an said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Contained lined concrete washout bay truck chute washing into collection basin, stream distant and protected.

pages.zhText: 回家后，妈妈拿出密封的小瓶，里面装着水和干净小石子。安安轻轻转一转，再放稳观察：“混在一起和沉下来，样子不一样！”
pages.enText: At home, Mom brought a sealed bottle of water and clean pebbles. An'an gently rolled it, then watched it settle. “Mixed and settled look different!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Home Mom supervising sealed clear bottle with water pebbles child gently rolling on padded table, no cement at home.

pages.zhText: 猜一猜：滚筒转动，是让材料均匀些，还是保证它永远不会硬？安安把玩具车推过去：“还要看时间和检查结果呢！”
pages.enText: Does turning help the mix stay uniform, or guarantee it never hardens? An'an rolled her toy truck. “Timing and checks matter, too!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Toy green-white drum mixer on table beside blank clock face and sealed sample, playful child and Mom.

pages.zhText: 平台开放了，安安和妈妈站在上面看小桥。她想起那段绕路：“大肚子送来的，不只是材料，还有大家商量好的每一步。”
pages.enText: When the platform opened, An'an and Mom stood on it to admire the bridge. She remembered the detour. “The big belly brought materials—and a plan everyone worked on together.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Completed open riverside platform with safety railing, An'an Mom admiring small bridge in warm afternoon.
